title: Penthouse Magazine May 1986 Vintage
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, May 1986 issue. Features "Terrorists of the New Right — Homegrown and Ugly," "Teaching Your Wife to Swing: A Consumer's Guide," Michael Korda on America's business comeback, and "The Girls of Newlook."
Complete issue, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
